intro: Instance IRIs follow the SPEC.md IDs with `:` turned into `/`: `org:ueno-bank` becomes `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/org/ueno-bank>`, `src:acta-p05` becomes `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/src/acta-p05>`, `rec:loan:0007` becomes `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/rec/loan/0007>`. Because of the `/`, these cannot be written as plain `ucr:` prefixed names in Turtle or SPARQL: write the full IRI (or escape the slash, `ucr:org\/ueno-bank`). Named graphs: `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/graph/prosecution>`, `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/graph/rey>`, `<https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/graph/press>`.
result: Result: 35 concepts. 29 fully verified, 5 partially verified (main class found, one requested facet missing), 1 not found. 164 individual IRIs verified in files.

mapping.use: `rdf:type` of the node for `org:ueno-bank` and the other banks (Visión, Zeta, OTP).
mapping.notes: Bank is a subclass of DepositoryInstitution, which is a subclass of FinancialInstitution.
Subclass of both Bank and MonetaryAuthority.

mapping.use: `rdf:type` of the superintendencies; `uc:Authority` records it as `uc:fiboAnalogue`.
mapping.notes: MOVED: no `RegulatoryAgency` class in FIBO any more. `FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies.rdf` still exists but only re-uses the Commons class (it defines TaxAuthority, Examiner, RegulatoryCapacity...).
Lives in FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices, not in FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities. It is a FunctionalEntity (a role-like classification), not a legal form.

mapping.use: `uc:Organisation` is a subclass of `cmns-org:Organization`; companies with a known legal form are also typed `cmns-org:LegalEntity`.
mapping.notes: MOVED: `fibo-be-le-lp:LegalEntity` and `fibo-be-le-lp:LegalPerson` no longer exist (0 definitions, 0 references). `FND/Organizations/Organizations.rdf` is gone too. Commons labels use British spelling ("formal organisation").

mapping.use: `rdf:type` of the S.A. companies (Ueno Bank S.A., ITTI S.A.E.C.A., ...).
mapping.notes: No class for S.R.L. in this module; see BE/PrivateLimitedCompanies.
Still in FIBO (FND/AgentsAndPeople/People), now a subclass of `cmns-pts:Party`. `fibo-fnd-aap-agt:AutonomousAgent` is gone.

Shareholder and Shareholding VERIFIED. Percentage: Shareholding is a FinancialAsset counted in units (`consistsOfNumberOfUnits`); it has NO percentage property. The only ownership-percentage term is the datatype property `hasOwnershipPercentage` in the LEI module (GLEIF relationship records). `hasShareholder` has domain Issuer and range Shareholder (roles).
hasBeneficialOwner has domain Asset (not the company).
Control is a `cmns-pts:Situation`; ControllingParty is a `cmns-pts:Actor` (a role).

Affiliate VERIFIED. "Related party" in the banking-regulation sense (parte vinculada: includes relatives, directors, common operators) is NOT FOUND as a class. `cmns-pts:hasRelatedPartyRole` is only a generic role-to-role link. FIBO affiliation is defined purely by control.

There is no `Director` class: the class is BoardMember and the properties are hasDirector / isDirectorOf. No class for president, alternate director or síndico. Several Executives terms (AuthorizedParty, Authorization, LegallyDelegatedAuthority, hasResponsibleParty...) are DEPRECATED and moved to Commons BusinessAuthorizations.
Loan is a subclass of CreditAgreementRepaidPeriodically and DebtInstrument.

mapping.use: Extra `rdf:type` on a `uc:Loan` whose `uc:collateral` is "none" (as asserted).

mapping.concept: Line of credit / overdraft / open-end credit
mapping.notes: OpenEndCredit and RevolvingLineOfCredit VERIFIED. Overdraft: NOT FOUND as a class. It appears only in a `skos:example` of OpenEndCredit and as OverdraftFacilityPurpose (a loan purpose). OpenEndCredit is disjoint with ClosedEndCredit.
In FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt, not in LOAN. hasLender has range Lender (a party role), so `uc:lender` is not a sub-property.
Same role pattern: hasBorrower has range Borrower. No notion of a nominal versus real borrower.
hasPrincipalAmount has range MonetaryAmount (an object, not a number).
InterestRate class is in FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount; the property is in FBC Debt.
`hasOriginalTimeToMaturity` carries the label "has time to maturity". hasTerm has range `cmns-dt:Duration`.

mapping.use: Documentation only; a claimed mortgage is recorded as `uc:collateral "mortgage_claimed"`.
mapping.notes: In FIBO a Mortgage is a SecurityAgreement (the lien on real property), NOT a loan. The loan is LoanSecuredByRealEstate.

mapping.use: Documentation only (pagarés mentioned in the record).
mapping.notes: In FBC/FinancialInstruments, a subclass of DebtInstrument.
There is no `hasIssuer` property; the pair is `fibo-fnd-rel-rel:isIssuedBy` / `issues`.

mapping.use: Documentation only (CDAs held by IPS and others).
mapping.notes: In FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccounts as a CashInstrument, not in SEC.

mapping.use: Documentation only; accounts are not modelled as nodes.
`uc:Flow` lists Payment as `uc:fiboAnalogue`; `uc:fromParty` / `uc:toParty` point to Payer / Payee.
mapping.notes: Payment VERIFIED (an Occurrence). PaymentEvent is an OccurrenceKind (a classifier), not an individual event. A funds-transfer event between two arbitrary parties is NOT FOUND; only ElectronicFundsTransferService (a service) exists.

mapping.use: `uc:currency` has range Currency and takes the individuals `fibo-fnd-acc-4217:PYG` / `:USD`; `uc:amount` is a plain decimal.
mapping.notes: hasAmount is a datatype property (xsd:decimal). The ISO 4217 individuals PYG, Guarani, USD exist.

Buyer and Seller are in FND/ProductsAndServices, not FND/Agreements/Contracts. Sale is modelled as a subclass of TransactionEvent (an OccurrenceKind) and of Situation, so it is not used as a superclass.
NOT FOUND: no loan sale, loan assignment, assignor or assignee term in LOAN, FBC or SEC. Nearest alternatives listed (generic Sale; contracts that can be assigned; a Portfolio collection).

mapping.use: Documentation only (personal guarantees mentioned by the record).
mapping.notes: Spelled "guaranty"; own module FBC/DebtAndEquities/Guaranty.

mapping.use: Company RUC, where a source states it, could be typed TaxIdentifier. Never recorded for persons (SPEC rule 4).
mapping.notes: No `hasTaxIdentifier` property; link with `cmns-id:identifies` / `isIdentifiedBy`.

terms.label: Government of the Republic of Paraguay

mapping.use: `uc:allegedOffence` is free text; the jurisdiction individual can be attached to the case node.
mapping.notes: Law is in FIBO (FND/Law/LegalCore); Jurisdiction MOVED to Commons RegulatoryAgencies (`FND/Law/Jurisdiction.rdf` is gone). FIBO ships a `JurisdictionOfParaguay` individual.

mapping.use: Not instantiated: `uc:onDate`, `uc:startDate`, `uc:endDate` are typed literals with `uc:datePrecision`.
mapping.notes: MOVED: `fibo-fnd-dt-fd:Date`, `DatePeriod`, `hasDate` no longer exist; FinancialDates.rdf only keeps schedules and business-day terms. Commons dates are objects (a Date node with `hasDateValue`), not literals.

mapping.use: `uc:Flow` and `uc:CaseEvent` are subclasses of Occurrence; `uc:involvesParty rdfs:subPropertyOf cmns-pts:hasParty`.
mapping.notes: Occurrence VERIFIED. It has NO participant property (only hasEventDate, hasInput/hasOutput, isTriggeredBy). Participants are modelled on `cmns-pts:Situation` (hasParty, hasActor, hasUndergoer).

differs: **`LegalEntity`, `LegalPerson`, `Organization`, `FormalOrganization`, `RegulatoryAgency`, `Jurisdiction`, `Date`, `DatePeriod`, `PartyRole`, `Situation`, `Identifier` are no longer FIBO classes.** They live in the OMG Commons Ontology Library (`https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/...`). The old IRIs (`fibo-be-le-lp:LegalEntity`, `fibo-fnd-org-org:Organization`, `fibo-fnd-org-fm:FormalOrganization`, `fibo-fbc-fct-rga:RegulatoryAgency`, `fibo-fnd-law-jur:Jurisdiction`, `fibo-fnd-dt-fd:Date`, `fibo-fnd-pty-rl:PartyInRole`, `fibo-fnd-pty-pty:IndependentParty`, `fibo-fnd-aap-agt:AutonomousAgent`, `fibo-fnd-rel-rel:hasIdentity`) are not declared in any file of the current repository. `FND/Parties/Roles.rdf`, `FND/Organizations/Organizations.rdf` and `FND/Law/Jurisdiction.rdf` no longer exist.

**Lender, Borrower, Debtor, Creditor, Collateral, hasLender, hasBorrower, hasInterestRate, hasMaturityDate are in `FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt`, not in `LOAN`.** `LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans` keeps Loan, SecuredLoan, UnsecuredLoan, OpenEndCredit, ClosedEndCredit and `hasPrincipalAmount`.

**Object properties point at roles, not parties.** `hasBorrower` has range `Borrower`, `hasLender` range `Lender`, `hasBuyer` range `Buyer`, `hasShareholder` domain `Issuer` and range `Shareholder`; all of these are `cmns-pts:PartyRole` subclasses. A faithful FIBO graph needs an extra role node per party per relationship.
**`Mortgage` is the security agreement, not the loan** (`LoanSecuredByRealEstate` is the loan).
**`PaymentEvent`, `TransactionEvent` and therefore `Sale` are `OccurrenceKind`s**, i.e. classifiers of events, not events. The individual event class is `Payment` (an `Occurrence`).
**`Shareholding` has no percentage.** The only ownership-percentage property is `fibo-be-le-lei:hasOwnershipPercentage` in the LEI (GLEIF) module.

**Deprecated in `BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives`**: `AuthorizedParty`, `AuthorizingParty`, `Authorization`, `LegallyDelegatedAuthority`, `hasResponsibleParty`, `hasAuthorizedParty`, `delegatesControlTo` and related properties (replaced by Commons `BusinessAuthorizations`). **Deprecated in `FND/Accounting/AccountingEquity`**: `ShareholdersEquity`, `OwnersEquity`, `RetainedEarnings`, `FinancialAsset`, `PhysicalAsset`, `Income` (moved to `FND/OwnershipAndControl/Ownership`).
Commons labels use British spelling ("organisation", "formal organisation") while the IRIs keep the `z`.
lacks: **Claim-level provenance.** FIBO describes what is the case. It has no way to say who asserts a loan, a shareholding or a flow, from which page, with what reading confidence, or that two voices disagree. Hence `uc:Assertion`, `uc:assertedBy`, `uc:confidence`, `uc:locator`, `uc:quote`, `uc:sameSubjectAs`, `uc:Issue`, plus PROV-O and named graphs.
**Nominal borrower versus ultimate recipient.** A loan has a borrower role and nothing for the party alleged to have really received the money (`uc:nominalBorrower`, `uc:ultimateRecipient`).

**Related party in the prudential sense.** Only control-based `Affiliate`. Nothing for "declared as related by the bank" versus "assessed as related by the supervisor" (`uc:declaredRelatedTo`, `uc:assessedRelatedTo`), nor for the indicators used to argue it: kinship (`uc:relativeOf`, `uc:kinshipDegree`), shared address (`uc:sharesAddressWith`), shared operator (`uc:sharesOperatorWith`). No related-party lending limit or exposure concept.
**Kinship between persons.** No family-relationship property at all.
**Overdraft** as a product class, and **sale / assignment of a loan or loan portfolio** (`uc:Overdraft`, `uc:PortfolioSale`).
**A generic money movement between two arbitrary parties** with an instrument (cash, cheque, transfer, bond purchase): `Payment` assumes an obligation being fulfilled (`uc:Flow`, `uc:instrument`).

**Ownership percentage on a shareholding**, and time-bounded role holdings with a role type in one node (`uc:RoleHolding`). FIBO needs Shareholder + Shareholding + Ownership situation + date period nodes.
**Civil-law corporate roles**: síndico (statutory auditor) and suplentes (alternates), president / vice-president of the board, registry agent (gestor).

**Criminal procedure**: no offence, charge, indictment, suspect or precautionary-measure terms (only `LegalProceeding` / `CourtJudgment` in LOAN, for loan defaults). Hence `uc:Charge`, `uc:allegedOffence`, `uc:proceduralMeasure`.
**Supervisory actions** (inspection, finding, sanction, intervention) and **depositor events**: nothing beyond `RegulatoryAgency` / `regulates`.
**Imprecise dates** (month or year only) and **participants on `Occurrence`**.

**Paraguay-specific reference data**: FIBO has `JurisdictionOfParaguay`, `GovernmentOfTheRepublicOfParaguay` and the `PYG` currency, but no BCP, Superintendencia de Bancos, RUC scheme or Paraguayan legal forms (S.A., S.A.E.C.A., S.R.L., E.A.S.).
query_prefixes:
PREFIX uc:   <https://w3id.org/ueno-case/ont#>
PREFIX ucr:  <https://w3id.org/ueno-case/id/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
query_note: All queries assume these prefixes and run on the default (union) graph unless a `GRAPH` clause is shown.

queries.title: Q1. Loans whose nominal borrower differs from the alleged ultimate recipients
queries.note: The result is "X alleges that the proceeds of loan L went to R", never "R received".

queries.title: Q2. Chains of flows that start and end at the same party within 7 days (2 or 3 hops)
queries.note: Only day-precision dates take part (month- and year-only literals are typed `xsd:gYearMonth` / `xsd:gYear`). The chain is kept inside one voice (`?who`) so that prosecution and suspect statements are not stitched together. The window test uses date + duration arithmetic (`?d1 + "P7D"`), which is an extension to SPARQL 1.1 that rdflib, Jena, GraphDB and Stardog support; the form `?dLast - ?d1 <= "P7D"` returns nothing in rdflib, so do not use it there.

queries.title: Q3. People holding roles in two or more borrowers
Q4. Assertions made only by the suspect
queries.note: Statements in the suspect's graph that no other voice corroborates: no `uc:sameSubjectAs` link to an assertion by anyone else and, for flows, no flow between the same two parties asserted by another voice.

queries.title: Q5. Data points with low confidence, with their source and any open data issue
queries.note: Q5 needs `ontology.ttl` loaded alongside the data (for the `rdfs:subClassOf` join); drop that line to run on data alone.

queries.title: Q6. Analyst estimates and the sourced assertions each one rests on
queries.note:
Opinions live in their own named graph (`.../id/graph/analysis`) and are asserted by `uc:Analyst`. Each row pairs one estimate with one of the assertions it cites, showing that assertion's own voice, source tier, confidence and source, so a reader can see what an estimate stands on.



An opinion without `uc:basedOn` still appears, with the basis columns empty. A basis assertion that an editor corrected has more than one `prov:wasDerivedFrom` (its own source plus the correction's), so it appears once per source. The estimate is never a sourced figure: read `?low` / `?central` / `?high` as "the analysts estimate", and the basis columns as "X asserts".
